comparator_definitions.B1: ElasticNetCV(l1_ratio [0.1,0.5,0.9], GroupKFold(5) on cells, random_state=42) on standardised [log var(dq), min(dq), skew(dq), Q0]
comparator_definitions.B3r: B3 with target y-100*Q0/1.1 (offset added back)
comparator_definitions.B4: RandomForestRegressor(300, max_features=0.33, random_state=42) on [dq[:, grid], Q0], absolute target; min_samples_leaf in {1,2,3,5} chosen by Protocol D closeness to the frozen value
comparator_definitions.B4r: same forest, target y-100*Q0/1.1, leaf = frozen b4r_leaf
comparator_definitions.common: stride-5 cell-balanced rows via train_rows(cells, 42); same windows, features and Q0; absolute SOH in pp unless stated

label_lock: batch-3 soh_nom is read only after the predictions_written log entry; y_work = 90.0 for every batch-3 row until then
name: Phase 7a locked batch-3 test (Protocol S)

pass_rule_D68.formal_comparators: B0b, B3, B4; B1 only if it passed the reproduction check in S5
pass_rule_D68.rule: PASS iff M0 cell-macro MAE <= the lowest cell-macro MAE among the formal comparators refit on all 84 development cells
pass_rule_D68.sensitivity: all numbers also reported without the batch-3 cells whose policy_norm occurs among the 84 development cells
pass_rule_D68.statistic: cell-macro MAE = mean over the 40 batch-3 cells of per-cell MAE (pp)

frozen_config.rule: D69: per window, the (lr, wd) of M0 with the lowest mean inner MAE pooled over all rows of outputs/phase5b/tuning_log_5b.csv for that window; B4r leaf by the same pooled rule

protocol.model: M0 (5-seed ensemble mean, seeds 42-46), no cycle index
protocol.train: all 84 development cells (batches 1+2), stride-5 cell-balanced rows, per-seed offsets
protocol.training: from scratch, fp32, TF32 off, deterministic

reproduction_rule.data: development cells only, Protocol D (3 repeats x 6 outer folds), cell-macro MAE averaged over repeats
reproduction_rule.tolerance: B0b, B3, B4 within 5% (failure = WARN, continue with these definitions); B1 within 10% else excluded from the formal rule

secondary_lines.deployment_decision: Phase 8: M0 at W240 (M0+idx selectable); made from development evidence, fixed here
